subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: What should happen when a GitHub-backed publisher’s sources or catalog exceed a fixed display-manifest read budget?
rationale: Bounding this query requires deciding whether large publishers lose custom manifest presentation, receive partial presentation, or require a precomputed full-catalog representation; those outcomes are user-visible and have different data-model costs.

options.title: Cap and fall back
options.body: Apply explicit source and item scan limits, then use the complete indexed paginated catalog when those limits are exceeded.

options.title: Precompute full display
options.body: Materialize the complete display payload during source or catalog writes, accepting broader schema, invalidation, and migration work.

options.title: Enforce a size ceiling
options.body: Retain the all-catalog contract but reject or disable custom manifests beyond a documented maximum publisher size.

recommendation.title: Cap and fall back
recommendation.body: Apply explicit source and item scan limits, then use the complete indexed paginated catalog when those limits are exceeded.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the staged implementation history and explicitly identified the unresolved contract after merge.
